intent.note: Task clause: 'Put the plugin-owned state paths ... in one table in a shared module both read; attempt_refusal treats them as plugin-owned: never refused as the task's edit, never silently left out of the record (name them on a line)'. The diff adds _manifest_io.PLUGIN_OWNED_IN_CLAUDE with plugin_owned_under(). The writers' constants BACKUP_DIR_NAME and GITIGNORE_NAME are the table's, and ensure_claude_ignored reads GITIGNORE_NAME. attempt_refusal drops those paths from during/predates/undated, appends one 'plugin-owned state ... left out of this commit and not refused: <path> (<why>)' note and records attribution.pluginOwned. Clause 'cover .claude/audit.config.json by the same table if it belongs' is done. The executor's outcome describes the diff accurately. It flagged the missing tools/gate-parity.py row, which is now present and matches the exact text it proposed (the instrument check resolves: case 'ctw-at9 ' is in the test file). The outcome also states what is not covered: the plan gate's .claude/** exemption in hooks/require-plan.py does not read the table, so the task's 'both read it' half is met for the writers and the commit check only. Checked against the orchestrator's questions, using split_plugin_owned and plugin_owned_rels called on a sub-project layout. (a) Normalisation: paths are git status -z output compared lexically through _task_outputs.covers, which uses '/' + prefix, so 'audit-backups-old/' and '.claude/audit.config.json.orig' are not matched. A '..' spelling would match, but git never emits one. (b) A file named like a restore point outside .claude/ ('audit-backups/x.py', '.claude/audit-backups-old/x', '.claude/Audit.config.json') is not matched and still refuses. (c) Symlinks: there is no filesystem resolution, only git's own listed names. A symlink entry is one path, and its target's changes are listed under their own names, so a symlink cannot launder a source path. A project/git_root spelling mismatch makes _rel return None, which drops the row and refuses, so it fails closed. (d) The left-out paths are still named: the note line is emitted from the same list that was removed, and attribution.pluginOwned carries them. ctw-at7/ctw-at8 assert the names in the close output. The one residual is finding 1 (content-blind match on tracked files).
